name: Legendary Green Steel Bastard Sword
description: Also known as a hand-and-a-half sword, and the largest of the single-handed sword, this weapon requires special training to use.

name: Legendary Green Steel Battle Axe
description: A sturdy, broad-headed axe used as a weapon, especially among dwarves.

name: Legendary Green Steel Dagger
description: A short simple weapon with a pointed blade used for stabbing.

name: Legendary Green Steel Dwarven Waraxe
description: This axe is too large to be used in one hand without the special training that all dwarven warriors receive.

name: Legendary Green Steel Falchion
description: This large, curved sword is essentially a scimitar designed to be used with two hands.

name: Legendary Green Steel Great Crossbow
description: The largest of the crossbows, it is weighty enough to require special training to use.

name: Legendary Green Steel Greataxe
description: A big, heavy, double-bladed axe wieldable only with two hands.

name: Legendary Green Steel Greatclub
description: A more formidable version of a simple club, this two-handed weapon is occasionally reinforced with spikes or bands of iron.

name: Legendary Green Steel Greatsword
description: The largest of the swords, this weapon can only be used with two hands.

name: Legendary Green Steel Hand Axe
description: A smaller version of the Battleaxe, favored as an offhand weapon by dwarves.

name: Legendary Green Steel Handwraps
description: Strips of cloth meant to be wrapped around your hands. They have small pieces of a foreign metal woven throughout.

name: Legendary Green Steel Heavy Crossbow
description: A ranged weapon consisting of a small bow mounted crosswise on a heavy wooden stock. This weapon is large enough to require a winch for reloading, yet is surprisingly simple to use.

name: Legendary Green Steel Heavy Mace
description: A simple weapon comprised of a solid blunt head attached to a haft.

name: Legendary Green Steel Heavy Pick
description: A hammer with a sharp, pointed head designed to concentrate the force of its blow on a small area. Similar to a miner's pick, but reinforced for battle.

name: Legendary Green Steel Kama
description: A weapon with a straight inside edge attached perpendicularly to a thin wooden haft and wielded with one hand.

name: Legendary Green Steel Khopesh
description: An ancient sword with a heavy spine and a single blade.

name: Legendary Green Steel Kukri
description: A heavy, curved knife with a sharp edge on the inside of the curve.

name: Legendary Green Steel Light Crossbow
description: A simple ranged weapon consisting of a small bow mounted crosswise on a light wooden stock.

name: Legendary Green Steel Light Hammer
description: A small sledge with a blunt, square head.

name: Legendary Green Steel Light Mace
description: A smaller simple weapon comprised of a solid blunt head attached to a haft.

name: Legendary Green Steel Light Pick
description: A small hammer with a sharp, pointed head designed to concentrate the force of its blow on a small area. Similar to a miner's pick, but smaller and reinforced for battle.

name: Legendary Green Steel Longbow
description: A large, curved wooden bow, often nearly as tall as a human. This weapon is popular among elves and rangers.

name: Legendary Green Steel Longsword
description: A classic straight-bladed sword usable in one hand. This weapon is commonly associated with knighthood and valor.

name: Legendary Green Steel Maul
description: The largest of the hammers, often created with a wedge-shaped head for splitting logs.

name: Legendary Green Steel Morningstar
description: A simple weapon comprised of a round, spiked head and a long haft.

name: Legendary Green Steel Quarterstaff
description: A long, stout staff used as a simple weapon. Often favored by wizards or common folk.

name: Legendary Green Steel Rapier
description: A long, thin sword with a fine point. Unlike other swords, this weapon lacks an edged blade, and can only be used for thrusting attacks.

name: Legendary Green Steel Repeating Heavy Crossbow
description: A complex weapon consisting of a heavy crossbow and a clip for bolts that is loaded by pulling the lever.

name: Legendary Green Steel Repeating Light Crossbow
description: A complex weapon consisting of a light crossbow and a clip for bolts that is loaded by pulling the reloading lever.

name: Legendary Green Steel Sceptre
description: A simple wooden weapon with a wide, round head and a narrow haft.

name: Legendary Green Steel Scimitar
description: A curved sword favored by the elves of Valenar. The unique shape gives this weapon a keener edge.

name: Legendary Green Steel Shortbow
description: A smaller wooden bow with a shorter firing distance.

name: Legendary Green Steel Shortsword
description: The smallest of the swords, light enough to be used as an offhand weapon but too large to be considered a dagger.

name: Legendary Green Steel Sickle
description: A simple weapon with a semicircular blade attached to a short handle. Typically used by farmers for cutting grain.

name: Legendary Green Steel Warhammer
description: A large sledge with a heavy, square head. Popular among dwarves as an alternative to the axe.

name: Legendary Green Steel Belt
description: A belt of green steel links.

name: Legendary Green Steel Bracers
description: Bracers with green steel plates.

name: Legendary Green Steel Goggles
description: Green steel forms the frame of these goggles.

name: Legendary Green Steel Helm
description: A helmet crafted from green steel.

name: Legendary Green Steel Necklace
description: A necklace crafted from a chunk of green steel.

name: Legendary Green Steel Weave Boots
description: Boots lined with cloth woven with threads of green steel.

name: Legendary Green Steel Weave Cloak
description: A cloak crafted from cloth woven with threads of green steel.

name: Legendary Green Steel Weave Gloves
description: Gloves crafted from cloth woven with threads of green steel.
